$comment: The ONLY way a built page, shared asset, media file, font or configuration file may differ from the pinned reference the baseline-bound checks compare with. Against the frozen v0.8 baseline this list held one entry, IMM-1 (the APR-JE-029 WebKit text-spacing @supports rule in styles.css, the only approved byte difference from v0.8). The reference is now the provisional Firelight commit (baseline-firelight-provisional.json), which already contains that rule, so there is no difference to explain and the list is empty again, as it was at Gate 1: the candidate must be byte-identical to the reference. IMM-1 stays on record in git history and in APR-JE-029; check:supports still holds the rule to its recorded behaviour. An entry needs an id, the file it concerns, a reason, the work package that introduces it, `visual: false` (it changes nothing a visitor or assistive technology perceives), and `normalize` rules (regular expressions applied to the CANDIDATE text before it is compared with the reference). A `visual: true` entry is refused unless it names an owner approval (APR-JE-nnn) that exists in docs/JADE_AND_EMBER_APPROVALS.md. Pixels, text, computed styles and behaviour are compared regardless of this list.
